compute_iou_between_boxlists: compute pairwise intersection-over-union scores between two numpy BoxList objects
run_non_max_suppression: run non-maximum suppression on a BoxList to prune overlapping boxes above an IOU threshold
clip_boxes_to_window: clip bounding boxes in a BoxList to fit within a given window and remove zero-area boxes
gather_subset_of_boxes: gather a subset of boxes from a BoxList by index and optionally filter specific fields
sort_boxlist_by_scores: sort a BoxList by a scalar field such as detection scores in ascending or descending order
